ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising edge that times all clocked processes. Drives updates of ctrl, divider and multiplier registers on rising_edge(clk_i).
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in control, multiplier_core_in_reg, multiplier_core_out_reg, multiplier_core, divider_core processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asynchronous active-low reset that initializes ctrl, divider and multiplier registers to defined reset values on rstn_i='0'.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in control, multiplier_core_in_reg, multiplier_core, divider_core processes

ports.name: ctrl_i.ir_funct3
ports.functionality: Instruction funct3 field selects multiply/divide variant. It gates valid_cmd, controls start signals, sets signed flags, and selects which result (mul/div) is forwarded to res_o.
ports.evidence: used in valid_cmd, mul.start, div.start, ctrl.rs?_is_signed, divider sign_mod logic, and case in operation_result

ports.name: ctrl_i.ir_funct12
ports.functionality: Bits of the instruction compared to detect multiply/divide group; used in valid_cmd condition to identify the instruction pattern.
ports.evidence: valid_cmd condition compares ctrl_i.ir_funct12(11 downto 5) = "0000001"

ports.name: ctrl_i.ir_opcode
ports.functionality: Opcode bit 5 is tested as part of the valid_cmd condition to detect multiply/divide co-processor commands.
ports.evidence: valid_cmd checks ctrl_i.ir_opcode(5) in concurrent assignment

ports.name: ctrl_i.cpu_trap

ports.name: rs1_i
ports.functionality: First operand bus for multiply/divide operations. It is used to form signed/unsigned operands for the multiplier and to initialize the divider quotient/remainder values.
ports.evidence: used in dsp_x formation, mul.prod initialization, and divider initialization and sign_mod computation in divider_core

ports.name: rs2_i
ports.functionality: Second operand bus for multiply/divide operations. It is used to form multiplier operand, to compute add term in serial multiply, and to form absolute divisor in the divider.
ports.evidence: used in dsp_y formation, mul_update expression, and divider rs2_abs and sign_mod logic

ports.name: res_o
ports.functionality: Outputs the selected operation result (lower or upper half of multiplier product, or division result). Driven when ctrl.out_en is asserted.
ports.evidence: operation_result process assigns res_o from mul.prod slices or div.res when ctrl.out_en='1'

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Indicates operation result is ready; driven high combinationally when ctrl.state equals S_DONE.
ports.evidence: valid_o <= '1' when (ctrl.state = S_DONE) else '0'

signals.name: valid_cmd
signals.functionality: Combinational signal asserted when ctrl_i fields match the multiply/divide instruction pattern and co-processor ALU bit; gates start of mul/div processing.
signals.evidence: valid_cmd <= '1' when (ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu = '1') ... ((ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2) = '0') or ((ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2) = '1') and DIVISION_EN))

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Record holding FSM state, counter and flags. It is updated in the clocked control process and provides gating and configuration to multiplier/divider logic.
signals.evidence: signal ctrl : ctrl_t declaration and assignments in control process

signals.name: ctrl.state
signals.functionality: Holds S_IDLE/S_BUSY/S_DONE across clock cycles. Updated in the control process according to valid_cmd, counter and cpu_trap; its value enables result emission and progression of cores.
signals.evidence: control process assigns ctrl.state; used in operation_result and in multiplier/divider processes (e.g. elsif (ctrl.state /= S_IDLE) then ...)

signals.name: ctrl.cnt
signals.functionality: Holds countdown used to track multi-cycle serial operations. Loaded to XLEN-2 and decremented each cycle; its zero condition ends BUSY state.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cnt assigned/decremented in control process; or_reduce_f(ctrl.cnt) = '0' tested to finish operation

signals.name: ctrl.rs1_is_signed
signals.functionality: Combinational flag derived from funct3 that indicates whether rs1 should be treated signed. It is used when forming multiplier/divider operands.
signals.evidence: ctrl.rs1_is_signed <= '1' when (ctrl_i.ir_funct3 = op_mulh_c) ...; used in dsp_x formation and divider branch tests

signals.name: ctrl.rs2_is_signed
signals.functionality: Combinational flag derived from funct3 that indicates whether rs2 should be treated signed. It is used in multiplier operand formation and in serial multiply update logic and divider logic.
signals.evidence: ctrl.rs2_is_signed <= '1' when (ctrl_i.ir_funct3 = op_mulh_c) ...; used in dsp_y formation, mul_update and divider rs2_abs branch

signals.name: ctrl.out_en
signals.functionality: Set in the DONE branch to enable driving res_o for one cycle and cleared at each rising edge. Controls whether operation_result forwards internal result to res_o.
signals.evidence: control process sets ctrl.out_en <= '1' in DONE; operation_result checks ctrl.out_en before assigning res_o

signals.name: div
signals.functionality: Aggregate record holding divider control and data (quotient, remainder, rs2_abs, sign_mod, etc.) updated in the divider_core clocked process and used to compute final result.
signals.evidence: signal div : div_t declaration and assignments in divider_core

signals.name: div.start
signals.functionality: Combinational start indicator asserted when a valid divide/remainder command is detected; used in divider_core to initialize quotient, rs2_abs, remainder and sign_mod.
signals.evidence: div.start <= '1' when (valid_cmd = '1') and (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2) = '1') else '0'; used in divider_core if (div.start = '1') then ...

signals.name: div.sign_mod
signals.functionality: Register indicating whether final division result needs sign correction; computed at start from instruction variant and operand signs and used to negate res_u when required.
signals.evidence: divider_core sets div.sign_mod based on ctrl_i.ir_funct3(...) and operand sign bits; div.res uses div.sign_mod to select negated res_u

signals.name: div.rs2_abs
signals.functionality: Register holding the absolute value of rs2 (converted to unsigned if signed). Initialized on div.start and used as divisor in the subtraction step computation.
signals.evidence: divider_core: div.rs2_abs <= std_ulogic_vector(0 - unsigned(rs2_i)) else rs2_i; div.sub uses div.rs2_abs

signals.name: div.remainder
signals.functionality: Holds the running remainder in the restoring division algorithm; updated each cycle and used to compute div.sub and final result selection.
signals.evidence: divider_core updates div.remainder in both init and iterative branches; div.sub concatenates div.remainder(30 downto 0)

signals.name: div.quotient
signals.functionality: Holds the running quotient. Initialized from rs1_i (signed/unsigned) and shifted each iteration; used both in constructing sub computation and as candidate result.
signals.evidence: divider_core initializes div.quotient from rs1_i and shifts it each cycle; div.sub uses div.quotient(31)

signals.name: div.sub
signals.functionality: Combinational subtraction of concatenated remainder/quotient and rs2_abs used to decide the next quotient bit and update remainder in the iterative division algorithm.
signals.evidence: div.sub <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned('0' & div.remainder(30 downto 0) & div.quotient(31)) - unsigned('0' & div.rs2_abs))

signals.name: div.res_u
signals.functionality: Combinational mux between quotient and remainder depending on the instruction variant; provides the unsigned form of the result before optional sign correction.
signals.evidence: div.res_u <= div.quotient when (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2 downto 1) = op_div_c(2 downto 1)) else div.remainder

signals.name: div.res
signals.functionality: Combinational final result that applies sign correction to div.res_u when div.sign_mod indicates the result must be negated; forwarded to operation_result when selected.
signals.evidence: div.res <= std_ulogic_vector(0 - unsigned(div.res_u)) when (div.sign_mod = '1') else div.res_u

signals.name: mul
signals.functionality: Aggregate record that contains start flag, product register, add term and DSP operands/results; fields are updated in multiplier processes and used to produce multiply results.
signals.evidence: signal mul : mul_t declaration and uses in generate blocks and processes

signals.name: mul.start
signals.functionality: Combinational start indicator asserted when a valid multiply command is detected; enables loading of DSP operands or serial multiply initialization.
signals.evidence: mul.start <= '1' when (valid_cmd = '1') and (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2) = '0') else '0'; used in multiplier_core_in_reg and multiplier_core

signals.name: mul.prod
signals.functionality: Holds the 2*XLEN product (or serial shifting state) across cycles. Produced either by DSP multiply capture or by serial shift-add algorithm; its high/low halves are used to form res_o.
signals.evidence: mul.prod <= std_ulogic_vector(mul.dsp_z(63 downto 0)) in multiplier_core_out_reg; serial multiplier updates mul.prod and operation_result reads its slices

signals.name: mul.add
signals.functionality: Combinational addend computed from the current product high half (with sign) and rs2 (possibly signed) used in the serial multiply shift-add iteration.
signals.evidence: mul_update process computes mul.add using mul.p_sext & mul.prod(63 downto 32) and rs2_i(...)

signals.name: mul.p_sext
signals.functionality: Combinational single-bit sign extension derived from the product MSB and rs2 sign flag; used to form the extended high-half operand in serial multiply add.
signals.evidence: mul.p_sext <= mul.prod(mul.prod'left) and ctrl.rs2_is_signed; mul_update uses mul.p_sext

signals.name: mul.dsp_x
signals.functionality: Signed-extended version of rs1 captured into DSP operand when mul.start pulses. Used by the DSP multiplier to produce mul.dsp_z.
signals.evidence: multiplier_core_in_reg: mul.dsp_x <= signed((rs1_i(rs1_i'left) and ctrl.rs1_is_signed) & rs1_i) when mul.start='1'

signals.name: mul.dsp_y
signals.functionality: Signed-extended version of rs2 captured into DSP operand when mul.start pulses. Used by the DSP multiplier to compute mul.dsp_z.
signals.evidence: multiplier_core_in_reg assigns mul.dsp_y <= signed((rs2_i(rs2_i'left) and ctrl.rs2_is_signed) & rs2_i) when mul.start='1'; mul.dsp_z <= mul.dsp_x * mul.dsp_y

signals.name: mul.dsp_z
signals.functionality: Combinational signed product of mul.dsp_x and mul.dsp_y. Its lower XLEN bits are captured into mul.prod by the output register.
signals.evidence: mul.dsp_z <= mul.dsp_x * mul.dsp_y; multiplier_core_out_reg captures mul.dsp_z(63 downto 0) into mul.prod
